metadata.description: The Architect's AI-Native SDLC as installable Claude Code plugins: intent, spec, plan, tasks, human gates, requirement IDs and drift checks, plus consulting engagements.

plugins.name: ainf
plugins.description: Core artifact chain: intent.md, spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, five gates, traceability IDs, drift-check and git hooks; change requests, drift review, triage, retro and reviewer subagents.

plugins.name: ainf-engagements
plugins.description: Consulting engagements on the same chain: discovery to POC to SOW, phased delivery with sprints, SIT, UAT, traceability and go-live, an engagement workspace of ID'd ledgers with readouts generated from them, read-only incident response and red-account escalations. Requires ainf.
